description.value: A Subway sandwich franchise situated on Highway 97 in Clinton, BC, a small interior town and common waypoint for cyclists riding the Cariboo Highway corridor. As one of the few chain food options in this stretch of the BC interior, it offers a predictable, relatively quick meal stop with customizable sandwiches. Clinton sits roughly midway between Cache Creek and 100 Mile House, making this a practical refueling point on a multi-day touring route.
